principles: Canonicalize at contract write boundaries and compare one unambiguous identity.
Syntax and versioned evidence beat regex inference and silent reinterpretation.
Trust generated shared metadata only through narrow mechanical provenance.
Rollout and rollback must preserve historical readability without weakening blockers.
drivers: Eliminate repeat false scope blockers and metadata-only review churn.
Keep implementation bounded to Workstream E.

options.name: A: Canonical path module plus TypeScript AST anchors and provenance-bound shared metadata
cons: Requires schema/version migration and focused cross-component tests

options.name: B: Regex exclusions and path alias trial matching
C: Blanket source-root and B-META exemptions

chosen: A: Canonical path module plus TypeScript AST anchors and provenance-bound shared metadata
rationale: Option A is the only design that removes the root ambiguity while preserving fail-closed behavior, versioned evidence, independent rollback, and mechanical provenance. B and C reduce symptoms by broadening heuristics or exemptions and recreate the maintenance hazards this workstream exists to remove.

preMortem.scenario: Source-relative canonicalization maps an unintended path into allowed scope
preMortem.trigger: Ambiguous base, traversal, absolute input, or symlink segment is accepted
preMortem.mitigation: One declared base, realpath containment checks, reject ambiguity/traversal/absolute paths, and adversarial fixtures.

preMortem.scenario: AST rollout silently reinterprets signed historical anchors
preMortem.trigger: Parser semantics/version changes without artifact staleness
preMortem.consequence: Protected edits pass or old review evidence appears fresh
preMortem.mitigation: Persist anchorParserVersion, versioned readers, explicit stale/re-attestation, independent flag and rollback tests.

preMortem.scenario: B-META path exemption permits forged framework findings
preMortem.trigger: Classifier trusts path/storyId without gap_log content binding
preMortem.consequence: Direct metadata edits bypass cleanTree/scope gates
preMortem.mitigation: Bind trusted classification to canonical writer receipt/event plus content digest; missing/stale/mismatch/forged cases fail closed.

preMortem.scenario: New rollout flags interact and cannot roll back independently
preMortem.trigger: Shared mode switch or coupled schema branches
preMortem.consequence: Disabling AST also disables path fixes or corrupts readability
preMortem.mitigation: Separate flags, explicit compatibility matrix, and no in-place artifact rewrites.
